title: Five government service prompts on Kuya B, Gemma 4 E2B

panels.label: Kuya B, Gemma 4 E2B 3-bit, Android emulator

beats.text: The fee comes from a dated record, with its source line. The model only phrases it.
beats.evidence: Control 1: answer from records you own.

beats.prompt: What are the requirements for NBI clearance?
beats.text: The requirements as the agency lists them, with the page they came from.
beats.evidence: Control 1: answer from records you own.

beats.text: A date answer only when a record holds that date. The checker rejects any other date.
The hotline from the record, never from model memory.

beats.prompt: Report a concern about a barangay official
beats.text: Airplane mode is on. The report goes to the outbox and waits for the network. The model never approves an action.
beats.evidence: Control 8: keep the model out of decisions.
